terms.gloss: a distinguishing mark, a sign, a badge (of office or honour)
evidence: Cic. Verr. 2.1.152: bulla erat indicium et īnsigne fortūnae (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BC 2.6: nāvem Brūtī, quae ex īnsignī facile agnōscī poterat (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: nāvem Brūtī, quae ex īnsignī facile agnōscī poterat
phrases.english: Brutus’ ship, which could easily be recognised by its ensign
